content: अवात {%a.%} [<sab>न˚ ब˚</sab>] .²1 Windless, not shaken by wind; मिहं कृण्वन्त्यवाताम् <ls>Rv. 1. 38. 7</ls>. .²2 Not breathing the air. .²3 Not exposed to, or not dried up by wind; fresh; शुष्मा इन्द्रमवाता अह्रुतासवः <ls>Rv. 1. 52. 4</ls>. .²4 Unattacked, unconquered (<ab>Ved.</ab>). .{@-तम@} The windless atmosphere; आनीदवातं स्वधया तदेकम् <ls>Rv. 10. 129. 2</ls>.
